result.explanation: Track each byte as either null (unknown) or its stored value. A put is transactional: validate bounds and all overlaps before writing. Reads derive completeness and maximal unknown runs; clears null their range. The alternative of applying non-conflicting portions of a put fails on the overlapping-conflict example because the entire operation must be rejected.
result.mapping: The state array maps byte positions to known values or null. known is its non-null count; missing is the maximal contiguous null intervals within a requested read.
result.assumptions: Inputs follow the stated legal JSON contract and config.length is a safe positive integer.
